messages.subject: Tower light booking - date change
messages.body:
Hi,

We need to reschedule our tower light rental, the LED towable one. Our pour schedule got pushed back so the original dates don't work any more.

Can you check what's available?

Regards,
Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Delivery options - pressure washer
messages.body:
Good morning,

We want to book a petrol pressure washer and I'm wondering about delivery. Can you bring it to our site in Kempele or do we need to come pick it up from the depot?

Best regards,
Rakennusliike Törmänen Oy

messages.subject: Returning the concrete breaker
messages.body:
Hi there,

My rental period for the hydraulic concrete breaker is ending soon and I wanted to sort out the return. Can I just drop it off at the Oulu depot during normal hours, or do I need to arrange a time?

Ville

messages.subject: Re: Returning the concrete breaker
messages.body:
Hi Ville,

Thanks for letting us know. You can bring it to the Oulu depot during our regular opening hours, no appointment needed. Just make sure it comes back clean and with all the attachments.

Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager

messages.subject: Re: Returning the concrete breaker
messages.body:
Hi Outi,

Good to know, thanks. Actually while I'm at it - I'll probably need the same hydraulic breaker again soon. Could you check if it's available in a couple of weeks?

Ville

messages.subject: Re: Returning the concrete breaker
messages.body:
Hi Ville,

Sure, happy to check. Could you let me know the exact dates you're looking at?

Hanna-Kaisa Louhi
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Returning the concrete breaker
messages.body:
Hi Hanna-Kaisa,

I'll confirm those dates once I know more. Separate thing though - I got the invoice for the site cabin rental and one of the amounts doesn't look right to me. Could someone have a look?

Ville

messages.subject: Invoice query - compact track loader
messages.body:
Hello,

Quick question about the invoice for our compact track loader rental. A couple of the line items don't match what we expected based on the booking. Could you send us a breakdown of the charges?

Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy

messages.subject: Rescheduling 13t excavator
messages.body:
The demolition phase on our current site got delayed so we can't take the 13-tonne excavator on the dates we booked. What alternatives do you have available?

Pohjois-Suomen Purkupalvelu Oy

messages.subject: Returning the tower light
messages.body:
I need to bring back the LED tower light, the towable one. What are the drop-off hours at the Oulu depot? Open on weekends or weekdays only?

Thanks,
Ville Junttila

messages.subject: Site cabin invoice
messages.body:
Morning,

Got your invoice for the site cabin and there's a charge on it I don't recognise. Could you send over a more detailed breakdown? The total doesn't match what I had in mind from the booking.

Oulun Putkiasennus Oy
